summary: Gold customers get 15% off instead of 10% when the order subtotal is 100.00 or more.

rules.text: Quotes for gold customers with a subtotal of 100.00 or more use a 15% discount.
The page shows the new total and discount for a large gold order.
Gold orders under 100.00 keep the 10% discount.
Quotes for standard customers do not change.
Quotes for silver customers do not change.
